source: multiples of the normal-presidency attention share, anchored on Biden spring 2022 (GDELT) converted to core-corpus units

anchor.basis: Biden 2022 median GDELT share 0.78% of Belgian articles x measured core/GDELT scale 1.47

notes: Share floors are multiples (1x/2x/3x/5x) of the attention a US president normally gets in Belgian media, measured on Biden spring 2022 (with the Ukraine war on the front pages, so a conservative norm).
Deliberately NOT percentiles of Trump's own distribution: calibrating on the anomaly would normalize the anomaly. See methodology_review_2026-07.md.
Rank, dominance and breadth floors retained from v0-eyeballed; they compare against other figures on the same day and are externally anchored by construction.
Biden 2023 (median 0.0%) was measured but looks like a GDELT coverage artifact; it is not used for the anchor.
